description: Find sites for every restriction enzyme of enzyme_set ("common" = the 39 common enzymes by default, "rebase" = all 754 REBASE enzymes with a defined cut) on both strands of a DNA sequence.

topology.description: Whether the molecule is a linear fragment or a closed circle (plasmid).

enzyme_set.description: Which enzyme table to list from: "common" (default; the 39 common laboratory enzymes) or "rebase" (all 754 REBASE enzymes with a defined cut, the 39 included). Case-insensitive.

errors.message: Sequence cannot be null or empty

output.sites: includes EcoRI forward site at position 3 (cut 4) + reverse site

examples.name: Type IIS sites found only with the REBASE set

output.sites: 42 records from 14 enzymes: AbaSI, Alw26I, BcoDI, BmeDI, BsaI, BsmAI, Bso31I, BspTNI, BstMAI, Eco31I, EcoO157SI, MspJI, SetI, YkrI. BsaI: forward record position 2, cutPosition 9; reverse record position 23, cutPosition 22. The default (common) set finds 0 sites in this sequence.
